debt_context.summary: Pressured seller without formal distress at announcement: AHT's 10-Q (Aug 12, 2026) states substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern and names hotel sales as a source of cash. No loan event was tied to this hotel by then.

No documented trigger dated by Aug 12, 2026. The roughly $24.6M lender paydown appears only in the closing 8-K filed Oct 9, 2026 (sale closed Oct 6), after the announcement. Going-concern doubt is not a v1.1 trigger.
